[[Coronado Brotherhood of Steel|Coronado Brotherhood]] |rank =Elder |location =[[Coronado]] |status = |dod = |dod verified= |titles = |family = |TV actor =[[Brian Thompson]] }} The '''Coronado elder''' is a leader of the [[Coronado Brotherhood of Steel|Coronado chapter]] of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. ==Background== He is evidently considered an ally by [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]] of the [[Knights of San Fernando]], to the point of being included as a prospective supporter for a civil war against the dominant [[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 4)|Commonwealth chapter]], which Quintus claims "only takes and gives nothing in return." The Coronado elder seems rough and carries himself sternly. However, he is also confrontational and patriarchal, even to his fellow chapter leaders, making a misogynistic comment towards the female [[McRae|Elder McRae]] and calling out the [[Grand Canyon elder]] for his lackluster attitude, belittling him as a "yahoo." The '''Coronado knight''' is a member of the [[Coronado Brotherhood of Steel]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. He appears in [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]] of {{In|FOTV|noin}}.

==Background==
Nothing is known about his history other than his status as a [[Brotherhood of Steel ranks#Knights|knight]] of the Coronado chapter of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] by 2296. He later accompanied his chapter after the [[Coronado elder|elder]] received an invitation to a meeting being held by the [[Knights of San Fernando]] along with the [[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon]] and [[Yosemite Brotherhood of Steel|Yosemite]] chapters that year.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Golden Rule]]===
The knight arrives with the rest of his chapter aboard their [[Brotherhood airship|airship]] to the San Fernando chapter's newly acquired headquarters, [[Area 51]]. He stands in rank during the meeting of elders, witnessing their unanimous decision to rebel against the dominant [[Commonwealth Brotherhood of Steel|Commonwealth chapter]] to shift power within the wider Brotherhood back to the West Coast.
